label: D2 after choosing a1 and landing in S2 (rare a1->S2 transition), early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and the shown state is S2, i.e. a rare a1->S2 transition. The inputs at D2 (in_action=1, in_state=2) make this fully observable. Of 13775 dev activations, all but 2 fall on such steps (recall ~1.0), but the bare conjunction has precision 0.30 because the feature fades over the episode: firing rate is ~4% of D2 steps in trials 0-19 and essentially zero after trial 80. Adding ep_trial < 40 gives dev F1 0.75 / mass recall 0.89, which is what I recorded (ep_trial < 30 gives F1 0.77 but mass recall 0.78). It never fires at D1 or GO, never on a2 trials, and never on common a1->S1 or on the rare a2->S1 transition. Magnitude is largest when the a1 choice was a switch away from a previous a2 (prev_action == 2 covers 25% of the top quartile vs 5% of the bottom quartile; the top windows are a1->S2R after a run of a2 choices), and larger when the agent's value is moderate rather than high. Episode time as a gate is a correlate (an early-episode / uncertainty signal), not an exact rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
